title.narrative: Increase in annual sales revenue of firms directly supported through the project

comment.narrative:
The results reported relate to the beneficiaries of the two (2) cohorts of the FCP in BouakE and San Pedro.
Out of forty-four (44) beneficiaries of the FCP, including twenty-four (24) in BouakE and twenty (20) in San Pedro, the data collected relate to the turnover of forty-three (43). Some beneficiaries' data were unavailable because the support provided by the project only materialized in the last quarter of 2023 with the delivery of the equipment.
The data used to calculate the increase in turnover (turnover) relate to the turnover of the following periods: April 2022 – April 2023 and April 2023 – March 2024.

title.narrative: Average reduction in travel time on rehabilitated/upgraded roads

comment.narrative:
Measures the number of MSMEs supported through Component 2 in both cities.
More specifically, the data represents the beneficiaries of the three (3) sub-programs: CPA 1 (38), CPA 2 (21), FCP 1 (22), FCP2 (22) and PAC (146).

title.narrative: Kilometers of roads upgraded or rehabilitated

comment.narrative:
Measures the cumulative length of all roads upgraded or rehabilitated in Bouake and San Pedro.
All the road infrastructure planned as part of the project has been completed. These are: 1. the road to San-Pedro airport (2140m), 2. the road from Tolakouadiokro to BouakE (5724m), 3. the Balmer Way in San Pedro (3500m), 4. the national A3 in BouakE (8620m), 5. the rue des grumiers and the road from the CHR to Cargill (7398m); 6. the roads of the Wholesale Market (MGB) (1500m).

Measures the number of newly registered firms in the two cities thanks to support to formalization.
36 promoters from the first cohort of Business Plan Competition and 9 from the second cohort who have formalized the creation of their businesses with the support of PIDUCAS, i.e. a total of 45 new businesses created.

title.narrative: Area of parking or rest stops built or rehabilitated

comment.narrative: Measures the total surface area of truck parking rest stop to be built in San Pedro. The construction of the San Pedro parking areas is 97.8% complete.

Measures the number of both public sector and private sector actors trained by the project.
Several actors from the public and private sector have been trained through project activities. They include actors from :CI PME Agency; Ministry of Budget and State Portfolio; Ministry of Commerce, Industry and SME Promotion; DGI; Direction des OpErations d'Assiette; CNPS/ Coordination of the Operationalization of the Social Regime for Self-employed Workers; San Pedro City Hall; BouakE City Hall; Ministry of Construction, Housing and Urban Planning; youth and entrepreneurs participating in the Entrepreneurship program in BouakE and San Pedro; users of the BouakE wholesale market.

title.narrative: Land for which the usage and ownership rights are recognized

comment.narrative:
The data transmitted by the Land Registry services as of December 2023 give a completion rate of 58.5% of the taxed plots on which land information is available in the two (2) localities. No significant increase was observed at the end of March 2024.
During the land survey, a certain reluctance on the part of the local population was observed. However, the Land Directorate is working on additional streamlined procedures which, if implemented, should increase the coverage ratio.

title.narrative: Citizens consulted who consider their views have been taken into account in detailed urban plan elaboration process in San Pedro

comment.narrative:
Measures the degree of citizen engagement in the implementation of Component 3 in San Pedro.
The survey to measure this indicator has been completed. Although the results do not meet the target of 75%, at a rate of 62.65%, it is considered that overall, the opinions of the population were taken into account in the development of the Detailed Urban Plan elaboration process in San Pedro.

title.narrative: Citizens consulted who consider that their views have been taken into account in detailed urban plan elaboration process in Bouake

comment.narrative:
Measures the degree of citizen engagement in the implementation of Component 3 in Bouake.
The survey to measure this indicator has been completed. Although the results do not meet the target of 75%, at a rate of 63.82%, it is considered that overall, the opinions of the population were taken into account in the development of the Detailed Urban Plan elaboration process in BouakE.

title.narrative: Number of users of San Pedro's website

comment.narrative:
Measures the average number of monthly visitors to gauge investors and individuals' interest in the city of San Pedro.
The data used to compile this indicator is supplied by the Town Hall. A new website is in service, but not yet fully completed. Certain functionalities requested by the Mayor have not been taken into account. Also, the site is not regularly updated.

title.narrative: Number of users of Bouake's website

comment.narrative: Measures the average monthly number of visitors to gauge the level of interest by investors and individuals in the city of BouakE. The data used to compile this indicator is supplied by the Town Hall.

title.narrative: Financial institutions participating in the Partial Portfolio Credit Guarantee (PPCG)

comment.narrative: This indicator is measured by the number of Partial Portfolio Credit Guarantee (PPCG) conventions signed between SGPME and a financial institution. Six (6) conventions with Partner Financial Institutions have been signed.

title.narrative: Sensitive areas benefiting from physical measures to prevent accidents

comment.narrative: Data on sensitive points involving physical road safety measures are collected by AGEROUTE through control missions. This data relates to the six (6) completed roads.
As of August 31, 2024, SGPME had received calls on 2 underlying operations, representing less than 0.01 percent of the guarantee portfolio.

title.narrative: Loans introduced in the PPCG by participating financial institutions

comment.narrative:
A cumulative total of 940 loan operations have been introduced by four PFIs as of August 31, 2024. The other PFIs have not begun registration.
The cumulative volume of loans guaranteed as of August 2024 was FCFA 24,7 billion (US$ 41.8 million equivalent).

title.narrative: An operating contract for the newly built parking and rest stop area in San Pedro is signed.

comment.narrative:
A firm has been recruited and is working to propose a management system for the rest area. The progress report on the memorandum for the creation of the parking area management structure was submitted and validated. The stakeholders decided to create a company with public financial participation for the efficient and sustainable management of this infrastructure.
In view of the actions remaining before the creation and implementation of this structure, the indicator is not achieved at the closure of the project.
